scores.notes: Left den is a wide sandy pit walled in large, rough-cut limestone blocks with scrub and palms on an unpaved rim; right is a narrow, deep cylindrical shaft of small, regular brick courses with a paved slab rim and a wooden hatch. The masonry and the shape of the pit conflict.
Daniel (left, being lifted from the pit; right, standing at the banquet) has short grey hair, a short grey beard, a lean face and brown skin in both. His apparent age matches too.

Banquet Daniel (left) has clearly grey short hair and a grey beard; den Daniel (right, centre) has black hair, a dark beard and noticeably darker brown skin. The grey hair against the black hair is the conflicting cue.

Daniel climbing out (left, lower centre) has greying, light short hair and a grey beard with olive skin; den Daniel (right, centre) has jet-black hair, a dark beard and darker brown skin. Hair colour and skin tone conflict.

Den Daniel (left, centre) has a dark brown face, black hair and a dark beard, and is darker than Darius in the same light; vision Daniel (right, profile) has tan-olive skin, grey temples and a salt-and-pepper beard. The skin tone and greying conflict.

Den Daniel (left, centre) has black hair, a dark beard and dark brown skin; banquet Daniel (right, left of centre) is a gaunt, older-looking man with close-cropped greying hair, grey stubble and lighter olive skin. Hair colour, age and skin tone conflict.
Banquet Daniel (left) and Daniel climbing out of the pit (right, centre) both have short greying hair, a short grey beard, a lean face and olive-brown skin, at a similar age.

Vision Daniel (left, profile) and banquet Daniel (right) both have short dark-and-grey hair, a short grey-flecked beard, a lean face and olive skin. The banquet version is a little more closely cropped, but no cue clearly conflicts.

Left pit is a hole sunk flush in open ground, walled in neat, regular stone courses, with an iron-bar grate at stone steps; right den has larger, rough grey blocks and a big round wooden door set in an arched wall above the rim. The entrance and masonry conflict.
Banquet Daniel (left) and vision Daniel (right, foreground profile) both have short greying hair, a short grey beard, a lean, long face and brown skin.

Vision Daniel (left, profile: dark hair greying at the temples, salt-and-pepper short beard, olive skin) matches the smaller Daniel climbing out (right, centre: short greying hair, grey beard, lean olive face).
Daniel being lifted out (left) and vision Daniel (right, foreground) both have short grey hair, a short grey beard, a lean face and brown skin.

Den Daniel (left, centre) has black hair, a dark beard and dark brown skin; Daniel being lifted out (right) has grey hair and a grey beard. The black hair against the grey hair is the conflicting cue.

Vision Daniel (left, foreground) has salt-and-pepper greying hair, a grey-flecked beard and medium brown skin; den Daniel (right, centre) has jet-black hair, a dark beard, darker skin and looks younger. Greying against black hair is the cue.
